title: Crash when the config file is empty
body: Running `tally --config empty.toml` with a zero-byte file exits with a panic: called `Option::unwrap()` on a `None` value at src/config.rs:42.

title: Panic on startup with an empty config
body: If ~/.tally/config.toml exists but is empty, tally panics before printing anything. Deleting the file fixes it.

title: Add a dark theme to the report page
body: The HTML report is hard to read at night. A dark theme that follows the system setting would help.

title: README install command is wrong
body: The README says `cargo install tally-cli`, but the crate is published as `tally`.

title: API token printed in the debug log
body: With RUST_LOG=debug, the request logger prints the Authorization header, including the full API token.
